cfg.title: Variants lifepaths
cfg.sub: Each dot is one variant at a half-year snapshot: when its publication growth peaks (left to right), how steep it is (lower is steeper), and how many papers mention it so far (size). 176 mentions across 160 variants. Each term appears in very few papers, so a fitted curve rests on a handful of points: read these as when a term turned up, not as a mature growth curve. Most terms sit in the “Deactivated” phase simply because the fit saturates after one or two papers.
